verdict.rationale: GitCafe has no native CI runner. Its documented first-party Buildkite integration shows builds on a repository's CI tab and as checks on pull requests, and GitHub-synced repositories receive GitHub Actions results as checks, so CI/CD depends on an external tool. Rulesets can require those checks to pass before merging. Missing for 10: native pipeline execution, documented pipeline-as-code config files in the repository, explicit evidence that builds trigger automatically on pushes and pull requests, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
